info.title: Opus Dental API
info.description: ⚠️ **Notice:** This is Opus API v1, currently in active use. A new v2 is in development and will replace v1 in the coming months. New integrations should be scoped accordingly — please contact us before starting to discuss the v2 timeline.

get.description:
Gets specific invoice for clinic.
InvoiceId and ClinicId are used for a specific invoice

parameters.name: InvoiceClinicId
parameters.description:
The globally unique id of the invoice. It is constructed from the invoice id in the opus database (int) combined with the clinic id (int clinicId and guid databaseId).
The values are combined using this template: {invoiceId:int}-{clinicId:string(clinicId:int-databaseId:guid)}

200.description: The requested invoice

get.description:
Gets Id:s for all not yet paid invoices. An invoice is unpaid if it has not yet been marked as fully paid (either manually or by settlement file handling).
ClinicId and InvoiceId can then be used to get details for a specific invoice (see Get specific invoice)

Note that the invoices might already be exported to external handling. This is just a summary of everything not yet paid.

parameters.name: SubscriptionFilter
parameters.description:
*Optional* - Changes the returned invoices based on whether they contain any subscription based invoiced items.

Valid values are:
  0 (All) - no additional filtering. This is default if no subscription filter is specified.
  1 (Subscriptions) - Only return invoices containing at least one Subscription related item
  2 (NonSubscriptions) - Only return invoices that contain no subscription related items

200.description: List of unpaid invoices

get.summary: Get exportable invoices for all databases

put.description:
This endpoint is used to confirm that an invoice has been exported to a third party, that now has the responsibility for the invoice.
In practice this means that the status of the invoice is set to Exported (4), and manual management of the invoice is restricted.

parameters.name: ExportType
parameters.description:
An optional decription of the export format. This is used to be able to group exports to a certain provider in the same daily batch.
The export provider will default to *ItbApi* if no value is specifed, or specified value is an empty string.

parameters.name: InvoiceOnlineId
parameters.description:
The globally unique id of the invoice. It is constructed from the invoice id in the opus database (int) combined with the database id (Guid).
The values are combined using this template: {invoiceId:int}-{databaseId:guid}

get.description:
Searches for patients based on the provided search criteria.
The search can be performed using the patient's social security number (SSN)/personal identification number.
Additionally, an optional Opus database ID can be specified to narrow down the search to a specific database.
Since this can search all databases, more than one patient can be returned.

parameters.name: Ssn
parameters.description: Restrict the search to patients with the specified Personal identification. Must be a valid personal identification for the specific culture.

parameters.name: OpusDatabaseId
parameters.description: Optional. Specify the database id to restrict the search to a single database. Must be a valid, non-zero guid if specified.

200.description: A list of patients matching the search criteria.

post.description:
Registers a new patient in the system, connected to the specified clinic and clinician.
The request body should contain the clinic and clinician ID in query string, while the patient details in the body in JSON format.

* Other failure modes: *
Invalid clinician id (400) : Returned when the specified clinician id is not a positive number
Clinic/database must be specified (400) : Returned when the specified clinic id is null or empty string
Invalid database id (400) : Returned when the specified clinic id does not contain a guid OR the database is not registered for this account
Invalid clinic id (400) : Returned when the specified clinic id does not contain an int
Patient must be specified (400) : Returned when body does not contain patient data
Registering a patient with a reserve number is not allowed (400)
Patient already exists (400) : Returned when the specified patient data already exists in database

get.summary: Gets the latest health declaration for a patient

get.description:
Gets a complete journal printout, and logs the printout in the patients journal. Response is \[0..*\] journal rows. A journal row is defined as follows: | **Name** | **Type** | **Description** | | --- | --- | --- | | RecordGroup | string | A string containing the type of journal row as presented in journal | | Status | string, enum | The status type of the journal row | | ClinicId | int | The id of the buisness the journal row is registered for. Note that this is the local format, not the globally unique. | | ClinicianId | int | The id of the provider this row is registered for | | ClinicianName | string | The employee number and clinic name of the provider | | CreatedDate | datetime | When this journal row was created | | TreatmentDate | datetime, optional | The treatment date of this journal row. | | DisplayedDate | datetime | The date to display in printout to customer. Based on created date and treatment date | | Text | string | The text of the journal row | | Surface | string, optional | The affected tooth surface, if any | | Tooth | int | The number of the affected tooth, if any | | InsuranceCode | string | The treatment and diagnosis code for this journal row. | | PriceType | string, enum | The rate type for this treatment:
H=high,
M=medium,
L=Low,
E=set by user, T=timebased | | DebitedTime | int, optional | The number of minutes when using time based price type | | ShareType | string, optional | The payment division type:
N=Normal,
P=Patient 100%
B=Child
A=subscription | | TechnicianAmount | decimal, optinal | The amount for this row owed to a dental tecnician | | Amount | decimal | The total amount | | IsSigned | bool | If the journal row has been signed by a provider | | CalculatedReferencePrice | decimal | The amount that SIO reimburses for this row | | ReferencePrice | decimal | The reference price according to the SIO price list |

parameters.name: PatientPersonalIdentification
parameters.description: The social security/personal identification number for the patient. Must be a valid personal identification for the specific country.

post.summary: Adds a free text journal row record to the patients journal
post.description:
Adds a single free text journal row to the patients journal. This row has the type misc and is already invoiced, so it will not affect the medical status or the economy. The body contains the following members:
| **Name** | **Type** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ClinicId | string (38-47) | The clinic id, containing database as well as the buisness to register to. |
| ClinicianId | int | Id of the provider to register the row for |
| Text | string (1-5000) | The text to enter into the patient's journal |

parameters.name: PatientPersonalIdentification
parameters.description: Personal identification of patient

get.description:
Gets references to invoices ready for export for a single clinic.
The return array contains invoice ids as well as which type they are.

parameters.name: DueAfter
parameters.description: Start of the interval. Only invoices with a due date after this date will be returned.

parameters.name: DueBefore
parameters.description: End of the interval. Only invoices with a due date before this date will be returned.

parameters.name: MaxStatus
parameters.description:
*Optional* - Changes the returned invoices based on their status. Only invoices with a status less than or equal to this value will be returned.

Valid values are:
  -2 (None) - No status
  -1 (NotHandledInOpus) - Invoices are not handled in Opus, are exported to external systems immediately
  0 (Created) - Invoice created, waiting for payment on invoice due-date
  1 (Reminder1) - Invoice not payed on due-date. Has sent first reminder.
  2 (Reminder2) - Invoice still not payed. Reminder 2 with warning that invoice will be sent to inkasso on a specified date.
  3 (SentToCollection) - Invoice sent to inkasso
  4 (Exported) - Invoice was exported
  5 (Mixed) - InvoiceBatch has mixed invoices statues.

parameters.name: SubscriptionFilter
parameters.description:
*Optional* - Changes the returned invoices based on whether they contain any subscription based invoiced items.

Valid values are:
  0 (All) - no additional filtering. This is default if no subscription filter is specified.
  1 (Subscriptions) - Only return invoices containing at least one Subscription related item
  2 (NonSubscriptions) - Only return invoices that contain no subscription related items

parameters.name: CreatedAfter
parameters.description: Start of the interval. Only invoices created after this date will be returned.

parameters.name: CreatedBefore
parameters.description: End of the interval. Only invoices created before this date will be returned.

NB! Changing order or inserting new enum in between will BREAK the permissions shown in older admin clients as they are serialized over the permissions API as integers.
It is important to update ApiPermissionsMinimumAdminClientVersion to latest version when making changes here.

RecordGroup.description: A string containing the type of journal row as presented in journal

Status.description: The status type of the journal row

ClinicId.description: The id of the business the journal row is registered for. Note that this is the local format, not the globally unique.

ClinicianId.description: The id of the provider this row is registered for

ClinicianName.description: The employee number and clinic name of the provider

CreatedDate.description: When this journal row was created

TreatmentDate.description: The treatment date of this journal row.

DisplayedDate.description: The date to display in printout to customer. Based on created date and treatment date

Text.description: The text of the journal row

Surface.description: The affected tooth surface, if any

Tooth.description: The number of the affected tooth, if any

InsuranceCode.description: The treatment and diagnosis code for this journal row. It's a combination of ProductCode/PriceListRateCode/alternative treatment.

PriceType.description: The rate type for this treatment: (H=high, M=medium, L=Low, E=set by user, T=timebased). Corresponds to RateGroup in model.

DebitedTime.description: The number of minutes when using time based price type

ShareType.description: The payment division type: N=Normal, P=Patient 100% B=Child A=subscription

TechnicianAmount.description: The amount for this row owed to a dental technician

IsSigned.description: If the journal row has been signed by a provider

CalculatedReferencePrice.description: The amount that SIO reimburses for this row

ReferencePrice.description: The reference price according to the SIO price list

ConsentUrl.description: Consent URL - where the consent was granted/signed by the patient.

StartDate.description: The start date of journal access interval.

EndDate.description: The end date of journal access interval.

Id.description: The on-premise identifier of the health declaration record.

PersonalNumber.description: The personal identification/social security number of the patient.

RegistrationDate.description: The date when the health declaration was registered.

SignDate.description: The date when the health declaration was signed.

MedicalTreatment.description: If the patient has had a medical treatment

MTNotes.description: Free text notes for medical treatment

StateOfHealth.description: An optional assessment of the patient's health. It has the following values: Good = 1, Medium = 2, Bad = 3

Cave.description: If there are any special concerns that providers need to be notified of.

MedicationFreeText.description: A free text describing patient medication use

Pregnant.description: If the patient is pregnant, and in which term

LastTreatment.description: Free text field related to dental treatment

VisitCause.description: The reason for seeking dental care

Locked.description: Indicates whether the health declaration is locked.

Invalid.description: Indicates whether the health declaration is invalid.

InvalidationReason.description: The reason for invalidating the health declaration.

HealthPropertiesList.description: A list of health properties to update. Note that the HealthFieldId of the properties must match the ones in Opus, or the request will be rejected.

Medications.description: A list of medications to update.

HealthFieldId.description: The id of the health field to register. From GET health

PropNB.description: Optional note related to the health property.
